body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> The way consumers interact with entertainment media is about to take a giant leap forward. MoovidaTM, a developer of software and services to enhance media consumption, today announced the US launch of the most comprehensive media player that lets users intuitively find, manage and play entertainment content, including movies, TV episodes, and music, regardless of format.
Unlike other media players that limit the type of content a consumer can interact with, Moovida
delivers an elegant and simple "find, manage and play" experience while preserving the freedom
of choice to enjoy entertainment media regardless of format. Moovida also does it within an
"Digital entertainment media, especially movies, is everywhere, but nowhere. Consumers have to
navigate a bewildering set of incompatible formats, competing content retailers with incomplete
media offerings, and closed or complex ecosystems that make it difficult and frustrating to enjoy.
At Moovida, we turned our own passion about movies into a tool that lets fellow movie lovers
everywhere find what they want and enjoy it when they want to," said Emmanuel Marquez, CEO
